title: A fresh retry of an ancestor_binding-held child refuses as task_sync_divergent_planning on an import-only host
outcome: A fresh retry of an ancestor_binding-held child refuses as task_sync_divergent_planning on an import-only host
acceptance: After an import exits 3 holding a new child as ancestor_binding (its ancestor's relation change applied), the documented 'fresh import can retry the child' path works on an import-only host: re-importing the same folder applies the child and exits 0, with a documented basis rule for that retry

The divergence check does not count a task absent both locally and in the basis (local=null) as a local planning change; a regression reproduces the DL560 case (60 applied, 1 held, then a retry) and passes
If a retry is genuinely refused, the refusal names the deciding comparison, the observed basis and local values, and a working remedy
